shared_elements: relief carving on an upright rectangular slab/pillar
a single dominant figure occupying the main face
profile animal/zoomorphic imagery (serpent-head and creature elements in A; quadruped in profile in B)
justification: Both surfaces present a single dominant carved figure filling the face of an upright slab, and both include a creature rendered in profile, but that is about as generic as relief iconography gets. A shows a frontal standing human in elaborate costume with towering headdress, serpent-head elements and dense glyph-like signs in deep, ornate high relief filling every space, whereas B shows one isolated bare quadruped in shallow, minimal outline relief on an otherwise blank surface — utterly different subjects and depiction conventions.
